title: Detector training length / checkpoint
criterion_preregistered: The D-FINE detector checkpoint (training length) is the epoch with the highest development AP at IoU 0.50 (p3_det.metrics.ap50 on the EMA weights, logged after every epoch in train_log.csv) within the fixed P3-06 schedule of the D16-chosen input size, trained on the LOCKED D08/D09 preprocessing; ties go to the earliest epoch. Only train (training) and development (selection) are used. The checkpoint is that epoch's ckpt_best.pt, identified by its SHA-256; inference uses its EMA weights. Its development AP50 is reported with a 95% percentile bootstrap CI over images, stratified TB/non-TB (B and seed from D21).
candidates: every epoch of the D16-chosen run
